remarks: A True Showstopper - Brand New Condo in Sought-After Heywood Heights!  Welcome to this stunning, beautifully designed condo located in the highly desirable Heywood Heights community. This super-stylish unit features an open floor plan, new hardwood floors, and custom moldings throughout, creating a sophisticated and inviting living space. The designer kitchen showcases high-quality stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.  The beautifully appointed bedroom offers comfort and style, complemented by a designer bath with exquisite finishes. A front-loading washer and dryer are conveniently located in the unit. Additional highlights include central air, a large private patio, a dedicated storage unit, and your own garage included in the rent. Heywood Heights is known for its beautifully landscaped, park-like grounds with mature plantings, a pool, clubhouse with saunas and showers, ample parking, and exceptional convenience - located just 0.8 miles to the train, close to the beach, I-95, and Chelsea Piers. A truly exceptional rental opportunity.
